The same object can reach RUN through the adoption form, for example RUN.tier = o.t || null. step() uses RUN.tier ahead of the roster (prelude.js:3366), so this pins every step. (2) Spellings of the tier key the tier: scan cannot see: the shorthand { story: id, tier }, the quoted key { 'tier': pick } (the stripper blanks it), the computed key { ['tier']: pick }, and a.tier = pick or a['tier'] = pick on the object passed to the child. still_open.proposed_fix: The toys and both spec skeletons reach RUN only as RUN.<field>, write tier only on the adoption line, never write model or effort in code, and never cut a ' or " string at a newline or leave a template open at end of file (probed). So use a closed rule over the code of the hand-written region: every RUN must be followed by . and a field name; the word tier may appear only on the RUN.tier adoption line; reject .model, .effort and .tier member writes and subscript writes; treat a string literal whose whole content is tier, model or effort as that key, so quoted and computed keys are seen. In _strip_comments_and_strings, report the file (fail closed) when a ' or " string meets an unescaped newline, and when any string or template is still open at end of input. Add one test for each form above, including Object.assign(RUN, m) on its own.
